method_notes: Compiled via 4 parallel research passes (web_search + direct web_fetch of contest/association primary sources) for the 20 largest US Census MSAs, Oct 2026. 'Active' requires evidence of a 2024, 2025, or 2026 edition from a primary or clearly reliable secondary source. Distances are driving-miles from the metro's core city unless noted. Several claims surfaced only by AI-search-summary (not independently fetched) are flagged inline as 'unverified'. 'none found' means targeted searches turned up nothing, not proof of absence. Some flagship events (Bear on the Square/Dahlonega GA, Everglades Bluegrass Festival/Miami, Detroit & Pleasanton CA Highland Games) feature live fiddling but a formal judged contest element could not be confirmed for 2024-2026 and are noted as such rather than listed as confirmed contests.
